summary: Held the entire episode. Price oscillated in a roughly -8 to +11 pt band around entry for all 15 frames without ever showing a sustained directional breakdown -- every dip was matched by a recovery within 1-2 frames, ER10 stayed low (choppy, not trending against us), and 1m/5m lambda_hat stayed net positive or near-zero rather than persistently negative. No giveback exceeded ~70% of leg amplitude with a confirming trend-against signal, so I judged the thesis intact rather than wrong-direction. Next time I'd watch for giveback consistently >50% of leg amplitude COMBINED WITH a negative multi-TF lambda_t (not just one dip) as the actual bail trigger, since single-frame drawdowns in this instrument look like pure noise.
